trigger_condition.shape_trigger: Tensor/buffer contains singleton dimensions that are indexed or squeezed, then broadcast against larger non-1 spatial dimensions, e.g., (1,3,1,1) with (1,3,224,224).
trigger_condition.state_trigger: Module registers a buffer or tensor with extra singleton dimensions.
trigger_condition.execution_trigger: ONNX Runtime executes an ONNX model exported by torch.onnx.export.
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Export a module where a registered buffer with shape such as (1,1,3,1,1) is indexed to (1,3,1,1) and used in a broadcasting binary operation with an input such as (1,3,224,224).

bug_oracle.description: ONNX Runtime BroadcastIterator initialization fails when broadcasting an indexed singleton axis against a larger non-1 dimension.
bug_oracle.signal: axis == 1 && axis == largest was false; Attempting to broadcast an axis by a dimension other than 1.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Mutate tensor shapes and indexing/squeeze operations to create singleton broadcast axes that must expand to non-1 dimensions in exported graphs.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Construct buffers or parameters with extra singleton dimensions and inputs with larger spatial dimensions; vary rank, singleton placement, and indexing axes.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Insert buffer registration, indexing/slicing, and broadcast binary operations before ONNX export; force singleton-to-non-1 broadcasting in the traced graph.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: register_buffer -> index/squeeze/select singleton axes -> broadcast binary op with larger input -> torch.onnx.export -> ONNX Runtime inference.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Run the exported ONNX model in ONNX Runtime and compare success, output shape, and values to the PyTorch reference; flag BroadcastIterator exceptions or shape mismatches.
